title: 전직대통령 예우에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Survivors' Pensions)
(1) A survivors' pension shall be paid to the spouse of a former President among the former President's surviving family members, in an amount equivalent to 70/100 of the annual remuneration of the incumbent President at the time of payment.
(2) Where a former President has no surviving spouse, or the spouse receiving a survivors' pension under paragraph (1) dies, that pension shall be paid to surviving children of the former President who are under 30 years of age and to surviving children aged 30 or older who are incapable of earning a livelihood. Where two or more persons are eligible, the pension shall be divided equally among them.
